description: This source file defines a singleton class 'TerminationSignalWatcher' which observes system termination signals (SIGTERM and SIGINT) and handles graceful shutdown procedures, including stopping pairing prompts and terminating the app.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for monitoring system signals indicating termination and executing shutdown procedures.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for termination signals (SIGTERM and SIGINT).

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels signal sources and resets termination state.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal source for a specific signal number, with an event handler to process the signal.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles received signals by logging, stopping pairing prompts, terminating the application, and scheduling process exit.
